note: Mood feed content for Bible Advisor. Each verse is referenced, never quoted: the app shows the exact text from the bundled KJV or WEB. Card 1 of every mood is 'What Jesus says' (jesus: true). Reflections and prayers were written for this app in plain English; they are not Scripture. Run `node tools/build.mjs` after editing to validate every reference.
crisisText: If you are in danger or thinking of harming yourself, please contact local emergency services or a crisis line now, and tell someone you trust.

moods.label: Anxious
moods.intro: When your mind will not slow down, God invites you to hand Him every worry.

verses.reflection: Jesus gives a peace the world cannot give or take away. His peace does not depend on everything going right. It comes from Him being with you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I receive Your peace right now. Calm my heart.

verses.reflection: The birds do not plan or store food, yet God feeds them every day. Jesus says you matter even more to God than they do.
verses.prayer: Father, help me trust that You will take care of me today.

verses.reflection: Worry tries to make you carry tomorrow before it arrives. Jesus asks you to live today with Him, one day at a time.
verses.prayer: Lord, I give You tomorrow. Help me live today with You.

verses.reflection: Instead of worrying about everything, you can pray about everything. Tell God what you need, thank Him, and let His peace guard your heart and mind.
verses.prayer: God, here is what worries me. Thank You for hearing me. Guard my heart with Your peace.

verses.reflection: You can throw all your worries onto God, like setting down a heavy bag. You can do this because He truly cares about you.
verses.prayer: Lord, I lay my worries down at Your feet, because You care for me.

verses.reflection: When many anxious thoughts crowd in, God's comfort can bring real joy to your soul. Turn each thought toward Him.
verses.prayer: When my thoughts are many, let Your comfort fill my soul.

verses.reflection: God keeps in perfect peace the person whose mind stays on Him. Peace grows when you keep turning your thoughts back to God.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep my mind fixed on You, and keep me in Your peace.

verses.reflection: God does not only take your burden; He holds you up while you walk. You do not have to carry it alone.
verses.prayer: Father, I hand You this burden. Hold me up today.

verses.reflection: Jesus invites tired and heavy-hearted people to come to Him. The rest He gives is for your soul, not only your body.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I am coming to You. Please give me Your rest.

verses.reflection: God is a safe place to run to and a strength you can lean on. He is near right now, in the middle of your trouble.
verses.prayer: God, be my refuge and my strength right now.

verses.reflection: God gives five promises in one verse: He is with you, He is your God, He will strengthen you, help you, and hold you up.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that You are with me. Strengthen me and hold me up.

verses.reflection: David could lie down and sleep in peace because God was the one keeping him safe. You can rest tonight because God does not sleep.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust You with this night. Give me peaceful sleep.

verses.reflection: The Lord is called the Lord of peace. He can give you peace at all times and in every situation.
verses.prayer: Lord of peace, give me Your peace in every part of my life.

moods.label: Afraid
moods.intro: Fear is real, but it does not get the last word. The Lord is with you.

verses.reflection: In the middle of a storm at night, Jesus came to His friends and said, "It is I." The answer to fear is not a thing, but a Person who is with you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, come to me in my storm. Help me hear You say, "It is I."

verses.reflection: David looked for the Lord, and God heard him and set him free from all his fears. You can look for Him today too.
verses.prayer: Lord, I am seeking You. Hear me and free me from my fears.

verses.reflection: If the Lord is your light and your safety, the things you fear are smaller than they look. He is the strength of your life.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are my light. Shine on what I fear.

verses.reflection: Even in the darkest valley, you do not walk alone. The Good Shepherd is with you and He protects you.
verses.prayer: Shepherd of my soul, walk with me through this dark valley.

verses.reflection: God told Joshua to be brave, not because the task was easy, but because God would be with him everywhere he went.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me courage, because You go with me.

verses.reflection: Fear does not come from God. He gives His people power, love, and a clear and steady mind.
verses.prayer: Holy Spirit, replace my fear with power, love, and a sound mind.

verses.reflection: This verse does not say "I will never be afraid." It says that when fear comes, you can choose to trust God.
verses.prayer: Lord, I am afraid, and I choose to trust You.

verses.reflection: God made you, bought you back, and calls you by name. You belong to Him, so you do not need to fear.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Lord, that You know my name and I am Yours.

verses.reflection: Like a bird covering its young with its wings, God covers those who trust Him. His truth is your shield.
verses.prayer: Lord, cover me with Your wings. I hide in You.

verses.reflection: God goes with you and will never fail you or leave you. That is the reason you can be strong.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that You will never leave me. Make me strong.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls His followers His "little flock." Your Father is glad to give you His kingdom, so you do not need to be afraid.
verses.prayer: Father, thank You for Your kindness to me. Calm my fears.

verses.reflection: Jesus is honest: this world will bring trouble. But He has already overcome the world, and in Him you can have peace.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You have overcome the world. Give me Your peace in my trouble.

verses.reflection: With the Lord as your helper, you can face people and situations with quiet confidence.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are my helper. I will not be afraid.

moods.label: Sad
moods.intro: God is close to the brokenhearted. You can bring Him your tears.

verses.reflection: Jesus knew His friends would be sad, and He did not tell them to hide it. He promised a joy that comes from seeing Him, a joy no one can take away.
verses.prayer: Jesus, meet me in my sadness and give me Your joy that lasts.

verses.reflection: When your heart is broken, God does not stay far away. He comes near and rescues those whose spirit is crushed.
verses.prayer: Lord, my heart is broken. Please come close to me.

verses.reflection: The writer talks honestly to his own soul and asks why it is so low. Then he tells himself to hope in God, because he will praise Him again.
verses.prayer: God, my soul feels low. Help me hope in You again.

verses.reflection: Weeping may last through the night, but it is not the end of the story. Joy comes in the morning.
verses.prayer: Lord, carry me through this night until the morning comes.

verses.reflection: God is a healer of hearts. Like someone gently bandaging a wound, He cares for the places that hurt.
verses.prayer: Healer, bind up the wounds in my heart.

verses.reflection: God promises to exchange: beauty for ashes, joy for mourning, praise for a heavy spirit. Jesus read from this part of Isaiah to describe His own mission.
verses.prayer: Lord, trade my ashes for Your beauty and my heaviness for praise.

verses.reflection: These words were written in a very sad time. Even then, the writer saw that God's mercies are new every morning.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Lord, that Your mercy is new for me this morning.

verses.reflection: God is called the God of hope. As you trust Him, His Holy Spirit can fill you with joy and peace.
verses.prayer: God of hope, fill me with joy and peace as I trust You.

verses.reflection: Tears are not wasted with God. What is planted in sorrow can grow into a harvest of joy.
verses.prayer: Lord, let my tears become a harvest of joy.

verses.reflection: David waited for the Lord, and God heard him, lifted him out of the pit, and set his feet on a rock. Waiting on God is not wasted time.
verses.prayer: Lord, lift me out of this pit and set my feet on Your rock.

verses.reflection: One day God Himself will wipe every tear away. Sadness, death, and pain will be gone for good.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that my tears will not last forever.

verses.reflection: Ask God to remind you of His steady love when you wake up. Then ask Him to show you the next step.
verses.prayer: Let me hear of Your love this morning, Lord, and show me the way to walk.

verses.reflection: God keeps track of every tear, like collecting them in a bottle. Your sadness is seen and remembered by Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that You see every tear I cry.

moods.label: Lonely
moods.intro: Even when no one else is near, you are not alone. God sees you and stays with you.

verses.reflection: These are among the last words Jesus spoke before He returned to heaven: "I am with you alway." There is no day when He is not with you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You that You are with me today and always.

verses.reflection: Even if a mother could forget her baby, God says He will not forget you. Your name is written on His hands.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that You never forget me.

verses.reflection: God cares about lonely people and places them in families. Ask Him to lead you to His people.
verses.prayer: Father, place me among people who will love me and point me to You.

verses.reflection: Even if the closest people in your life leave you, the Lord will take you in and hold you.
verses.prayer: Lord, when people let me go, You hold on to me.

verses.reflection: The Lord goes ahead of you and walks with you. He will not fail you or leave you.
verses.prayer: Lord, go before me and stay beside me.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls His followers His friends. He shares His heart with them. You have a Friend in Jesus.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You for calling me Your friend.

verses.reflection: God does not promise there will be no deep waters or hot fires. He promises to be with you in them.
verses.prayer: Lord, be with me in the deep waters.

verses.reflection: Even if you went to the farthest place on earth, God's hand would be there to lead and hold you.
verses.prayer: Lord, hold my hand wherever I am.

verses.reflection: David felt alone and hurting, and he told God so. You can be just as honest with God.
verses.prayer: Lord, turn to me. I feel alone; please show me Your mercy.

verses.reflection: Jesus promised He would not leave His followers like orphans. He comes to us by His Holy Spirit.
verses.prayer: Jesus, come to me. I do not want to feel alone.

verses.reflection: Nothing at all can separate you from God's love in Christ Jesus. Not death, not life, not anything in all creation.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, that nothing can separate me from Your love.

verses.reflection: God is not distant or cold toward His people. He is with them, He saves them, and He delights in them with singing.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me know that You are with me and You delight in me.

verses.reflection: When you take a step toward God, He comes near to you. Prayer is a step you can take right now.
verses.prayer: God, I am drawing near to You. Please draw near to me.

moods.label: Grieving
moods.intro: Grief is love that has lost someone. Jesus weeps with you and holds out real hope.

verses.reflection: Jesus spoke these words to a grieving sister before He raised her brother. He is the resurrection and the life, and death is not the end for those who believe in Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You are the resurrection and the life. Hold me in my grief.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls those who mourn "blessed," because God Himself will comfort them. Your mourning is seen.
verses.prayer: Lord, I am mourning. Please comfort me.

verses.reflection: Jesus told His friends not to be troubled, because He was preparing a place for them in His Father's house.
verses.prayer: Jesus, calm my troubled heart with the hope of Your Father's house.

verses.reflection: The shortest verse in the Bible shows Jesus crying at His friend's grave. He does not rush you through your grief; He weeps with you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You that You cry with me.

verses.reflection: The valley of the shadow of death is a real place in this life. The Shepherd walks through it with you.
verses.prayer: Lord, walk with me through this valley.

verses.reflection: A day is coming when there will be no more death, crying, or pain. God will wipe away every tear.
verses.prayer: Lord, I long for the day when You wipe away every tear.

verses.reflection: Christians still grieve, but not without hope. Because Jesus died and rose again, those who belong to Him will rise too.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me grieve with hope in Jesus who rose again.

verses.reflection: God is called the God of all comfort. One day, the comfort He gives you may help you comfort someone else.
verses.prayer: God of all comfort, comfort me in this sorrow.

verses.reflection: When your body and heart feel too weak to go on, God is still the strength of your heart.
verses.prayer: God, my heart feels weak. Be my strength.

verses.reflection: God promises to swallow up death forever and wipe tears from every face. Death will not win.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that death will not have the last word.

verses.reflection: Because of Jesus, death has lost its sting. God gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, for the victory over death through Jesus.

verses.reflection: Whether we live or die, those who trust in Jesus belong to the Lord. Nothing changes who you belong to.
verses.prayer: Lord, in life and in death, I am Yours.

verses.reflection: There is a time to weep and a time to mourn. It is right to give yourself time to grieve.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me grace for this time of weeping.

moods.label: Angry
moods.intro: Anger is a strong feeling. Bring it to God before it turns into words or actions you regret.

verses.reflection: Jesus asks something only He can help us do: love, bless, and pray for the people who hurt us. He lived this out, even on the cross.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I cannot do this alone. Teach me to love and pray for the one I am angry with.

verses.reflection: Listen fast, speak slowly, and be slow to get angry. Human anger does not produce the good life God wants.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me listen first and speak slowly today.

verses.reflection: Feeling angry is not always a sin, but anger can lead us into sin. Deal with it quickly, before the day ends.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me settle my anger before the sun goes down.

verses.reflection: A gentle answer can calm someone down, while harsh words make anger grow. Your words can cool a hot moment.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me gentle words when I want to answer harshly.

verses.reflection: God asks us to put away bitterness and rage, and to be kind and forgiving. We forgive because God forgave us in Christ.
verses.prayer: God, take away my bitterness and make me kind and forgiving.

verses.reflection: Staying angry and worrying about wrongs can pull you toward doing wrong yourself. Let it go into God's hands.
verses.prayer: Lord, I let go of this anger and give it to You.

verses.reflection: Controlling your temper takes more strength than winning a battle. God can give you that strength.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me the strength to rule my spirit.

verses.reflection: You do not have to get even. God is a fair judge, and He will make things right in His time.
verses.prayer: Lord, I leave justice in Your hands. I will not take revenge.

verses.reflection: Evil wins when it makes us act like it. Good wins when we answer evil with good.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me answer evil with good today.

verses.reflection: A wise person does not let every angry thought come out. Sometimes the wisest thing is to wait.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me hold my words until I am calm.

verses.reflection: When you are upset, be still and talk with your own heart before God. Quiet can stop you from sinning.
verses.prayer: Lord, quiet my heart. Help me be still before You.

verses.reflection: Patience, gentleness, and self-control are fruit the Holy Spirit grows in us. Ask Him for that fruit now.
verses.prayer: Holy Spirit, grow patience and self-control in me.

verses.reflection: Jesus blesses peacemakers and calls them children of God. Making peace can begin with you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, make me a peacemaker in this situation.

moods.label: Frustrated
moods.intro: When things keep going wrong or nothing moves, slow down and bring it all to Jesus.

verses.reflection: Martha was busy, stressed and upset that no one was helping. Jesus spoke to her gently and reminded her that only one thing is truly needed: being with Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I am troubled about many things. Help me sit with You first.

verses.reflection: When others seem to get ahead unfairly, it is easy to fret. God invites you to rest in Him, wait patiently, and let go of anger.
verses.prayer: Lord, I will rest in You and stop fretting.

verses.reflection: Frustration can quickly turn into anger. Slowing down before you react is wise.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me from getting angry too fast.

verses.reflection: Being slow to get angry shows real understanding. Rushing in frustration usually makes things worse.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a calm and understanding spirit.

verses.reflection: Hard and annoying times can grow patience in us. God is using even this to make you stronger and more complete.
verses.prayer: Lord, use this frustration to grow patience in me.

verses.reflection: Trouble can lead to patience, patience to tested character, and character to hope. This hard season is not wasted.
verses.prayer: God, turn my troubles into patience and hope.

verses.reflection: As God's loved and chosen people, we can put on kindness, humility, gentleness and patience, like clothes for the day.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me put on patience and kindness today.

verses.reflection: Three simple steps for hard days: hold on to hope, be patient in trouble, and keep praying.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me hope, be patient, and keep praying.

verses.reflection: You can pour out your whole heart to God, frustrations and all. He is a safe place.
verses.prayer: God, here is everything on my heart. Be my refuge.

verses.reflection: Not everything happens on our timetable. God has a right time for each thing.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me trust Your timing.

verses.reflection: David asked God, "How long?" four times. You can be honest with God when you feel stuck.
verses.prayer: Lord, how long? I bring You my honest feelings.

verses.reflection: The same psalm ends with trust and singing. Honest complaints can turn into praise as we remember God's mercy.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust Your mercy, and I will sing to You.

verses.reflection: The prophet felt God was not listening and said so. God answered him, and He hears you too.
verses.prayer: Lord, I cry out to You. Please hear me.

verses.reflection: The Lord is good to those who wait for Him. Quiet hope is good for the soul.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to wait quietly and hope in You.

moods.label: Tired
moods.intro: When you are worn out in body or soul, Jesus offers rest.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls the tired and the overloaded to come to Him. He is gentle and humble, and He gives rest to your soul.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I am tired. I come to You for rest.

verses.reflection: Jesus saw His friends were too busy to even eat, so He told them to come away and rest. Rest is His idea.
verses.prayer: Jesus, help me come away with You and rest for a while.

verses.reflection: God gives power to the weak and strength to those who have none left. Your empty tank is where His strength begins.
verses.prayer: Lord, I have no strength left. Please give me Yours.

verses.reflection: Those who wait on the Lord get new strength. Waiting on God means trusting Him and leaning on Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, as I wait on You, renew my strength.

verses.reflection: The Shepherd makes His sheep lie down in green grass and leads them by quiet water. He restores your soul.
verses.prayer: Good Shepherd, lead me to rest and restore my soul.

verses.reflection: When Paul was weak, the Lord told him, "My grace is sufficient for thee." God's power shows up best in our weakness.
verses.prayer: Lord, Your grace is enough for me. Be strong in my weakness.

verses.reflection: Doing good can wear you out. Keep going, because in the right time there will be a harvest.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me from giving up on doing good.

verses.reflection: Working without rest and worrying late at night is not God's plan. He gives sleep to those He loves.
verses.prayer: Father, I trust You with my work. Give me good sleep.

verses.reflection: Paul wrote this about being content in good times and hard times. Christ gives strength for whatever today holds.
verses.prayer: Christ, strengthen me for everything today holds.

verses.reflection: Lift your eyes up. Your help comes from the Lord who made heaven and earth.
verses.prayer: Lord, my help comes from You.

verses.reflection: God promised Moses that His presence would go with him and give him rest. His presence is your rest too.
verses.prayer: Lord, go with me, and give me rest.

verses.reflection: God promises to refresh the weary and fill every sad soul. He can fill what feels empty in you.
verses.prayer: Lord, refresh my weary soul.

verses.reflection: Rest is not only sleep. It is your soul waiting quietly on God, who saves you.
verses.prayer: God, my soul waits quietly for You.

moods.label: Tempted
moods.intro: Temptation is not sin, and you do not face it alone. Jesus was tempted and won.

verses.reflection: When Jesus was hungry and tempted in the desert, He answered with God's Word. Scripture is your weapon too.
verses.prayer: Jesus, teach me to answer temptation with God's Word, like You did.

verses.reflection: Jesus understands temptation because He faced it, yet He never sinned. So you can come boldly to Him for mercy and help right when you need it.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You understand. Give me grace and help right now.

verses.reflection: Your temptation is not unusual, and God is faithful. He always gives a way out. Look for it and take it.
verses.prayer: Faithful God, show me the way out, and help me take it.

verses.reflection: Saying no to temptation is not wasted effort. God blesses the person who stands firm.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me stand firm today.

verses.reflection: First submit to God, then resist the devil. When you do, he will run from you.
verses.prayer: God, I give myself to You. Help me resist evil.

verses.reflection: Jesus told His friends to watch and pray because the flesh is weak. Prayer helps you before temptation becomes strong.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me watchful and praying.

verses.reflection: Learning God's Word by heart helps you not to sin. Try to memorize this verse today.
verses.prayer: Lord, hide Your Word in my heart.

verses.reflection: The way to say no to wrong desires is to say yes to the Holy Spirit, step by step.
verses.prayer: Holy Spirit, lead my steps today.

verses.reflection: Some temptations should be run away from, not argued with. Then run toward good things, with friends who love God.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me run from wrong and toward what is good.

verses.reflection: Sin is not your master any more if you belong to Christ. You live under God's grace.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Lord, that sin is not my master. I live by Your grace.

verses.reflection: Your heart shapes the rest of your life, so guard it carefully. Pay attention to what you let in.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me guard my heart.

verses.reflection: What you think about grows. Fill your mind with what is true, pure, lovely, and good.
verses.prayer: Lord, fill my mind with what is true and pure.

verses.reflection: The enemy is real and looking for a weak moment. Stay alert, stand firm in faith, and know other believers face this too.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me alert and firm in faith.

verses.reflection: Put on Jesus like clothing, and do not make plans to give in to wrong desires.
verses.prayer: Lord Jesus, I put You on today. Help me make no room for sin.

moods.label: Guilty
moods.intro: When you have done wrong, God does not push you away. In Jesus there is full forgiveness.

verses.reflection: A woman caught in sin stood before Jesus. He did not condemn her. He forgave her and gave her a new way to live.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You for not condemning me. Help me walk in a new way.

verses.reflection: When we confess our sins to God, He is faithful to forgive and to make us clean. Tell Him what you did.
verses.prayer: Father, I confess my sin to You. Thank You for forgiving and cleansing me.

verses.reflection: There is no condemnation for those who belong to Christ Jesus. Your guilt was carried by Him.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, that there is no condemnation for me in You.

verses.reflection: East and west never meet. That is how far God removes our sins from us when He forgives.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for taking my sins so far away.

verses.reflection: Even the darkest stain can be washed white as snow. God invites you to come and talk with Him about it.
verses.prayer: Lord, wash me and make me clean.

verses.reflection: God loves to show mercy. He throws our sins into the deepest sea.
verses.prayer: God, thank You that You delight to show mercy to me.

verses.reflection: David prayed this after a terrible sin. God can create a clean heart in you and make your spirit right again.
verses.prayer: Create in me a clean heart, O God.

verses.reflection: David stopped hiding his sin and told God, and God forgave him. Hiding makes guilt heavier; confessing sets you free.
verses.prayer: Lord, I will not hide from You. Please forgive me.

verses.reflection: God Himself blots out sins and chooses not to remember them. If God does not hold it against you, you can let it go too.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me believe You no longer hold my sins against me.

verses.reflection: In His new covenant, God promises mercy and to remember our sins no more.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, for Your mercy and Your promise.

verses.reflection: In Jesus' story of the lost son, the father runs to hug his son before he can finish saying sorry. This is how God welcomes those who come home.
verses.prayer: Father, I am coming home. Thank You for running to me.

verses.reflection: Our forgiveness was paid for by Jesus' blood and given freely by God's rich grace.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You for paying for my forgiveness.

verses.reflection: Jesus came for people who know they need Him. Your sin does not disqualify you; it is why He came.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I need You. Thank You for coming for sinners like me.

moods.label: Confused
moods.intro: When you cannot see the way, follow the Light of the world one step at a time.

verses.reflection: Jesus is the light of the world. When you follow Him, you are not left in the dark.
verses.prayer: Jesus, be my light. I will follow You.

verses.reflection: You do not have to understand everything. Trust God with all your heart, and He will make your path straight.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust You more than my own understanding. Direct my path.

verses.reflection: If you need wisdom, ask God. He gives generously and does not scold you for asking.
verses.prayer: God, I need wisdom. Please give it to me.

verses.reflection: God's Word is like a lamp for the next step and a light for the road ahead.
verses.prayer: Lord, let Your Word light my next step.

verses.reflection: God promises to guide His people, like a voice behind you saying, "This is the way." Listen for Him in His Word and in prayer.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me hear You say, "This is the way."

verses.reflection: Confusion does not come from God. He is a God of peace and order.
verses.prayer: God of peace, bring order to my confused thoughts.

verses.reflection: God promises to teach you and to watch over you as you go. You are not figuring this out alone.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me and guide me.

verses.reflection: Jesus promised the Spirit of truth would guide His followers into all truth.
verses.prayer: Holy Spirit, guide me into the truth.

verses.reflection: God's thoughts are much higher than ours. Not understanding Him does not mean He is not good.
verses.prayer: Lord, Your ways are higher than mine. I trust You.

verses.reflection: This is a simple prayer to pray when you do not know what to do: show me, teach me, lead me.
verses.prayer: Lord, show me Your ways, teach me Your paths, and lead me.

verses.reflection: God invites you to call to Him. He answers and shows things you could not know on your own.
verses.prayer: Lord, I am calling to You. Please answer me.

verses.reflection: God is working in all things for good for those who love Him, even in the things that confuse us.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust You are working for good in this.

verses.reflection: Sometimes the next step is to stop and be still, and remember that God is God.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me be still and know that You are God.

verses.reflection: The writer could not make sense of life until he went into God's presence. Then he began to understand.
verses.prayer: Lord, bring me into Your presence so I can see clearly.

moods.label: Doubting
moods.intro: Honest questions are welcome. Jesus met doubters with kindness and with Himself.

verses.reflection: Thomas said he would not believe without seeing. Jesus did not reject him. He came and showed him His wounds.
verses.prayer: Jesus, meet me in my doubts the way You met Thomas.

verses.reflection: A father cried out, "I believe; help my unbelief." Jesus helped him. You can pray this honest prayer too.
verses.prayer: Lord, I believe. Help my unbelief.

verses.reflection: Faith means being sure of what we hope for, even when we cannot see it yet.
verses.prayer: Lord, grow my faith in what I cannot see.

verses.reflection: Faith grows by hearing God's Word. Keep reading and listening to it.
verses.prayer: Lord, grow my faith as I hear Your Word.

verses.reflection: When Peter doubted and began to sink, Jesus reached out right away and caught him. Your doubt does not make Him let go.
verses.prayer: Jesus, catch me when I sink.

verses.reflection: John wrote his Gospel so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life in His name.
verses.prayer: Lord, as I read about Jesus, help me believe.

verses.reflection: The heart of the faith is simple: Christ died for our sins, was buried, and rose again on the third day.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You that You died and rose again.

verses.reflection: The sky and the stars tell about God's glory. Creation points to a Creator.
verses.prayer: God, open my eyes to see Your glory in what You have made.

verses.reflection: Jesus promises that those who ask, seek, and knock will receive and find. Keep seeking Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, I am asking, seeking, and knocking. Show Yourself to me.

verses.reflection: God promises that those who seek Him with all their heart will find Him.
verses.prayer: God, I want to seek You with all my heart.

verses.reflection: Even when our faith is weak, Christ stays faithful. His faithfulness does not depend on ours.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for staying faithful when my faith is weak.

verses.reflection: After He rose, Jesus asked His scared friends why they doubted, and invited them to touch Him. He is real.
verses.prayer: Risen Jesus, help me see that You are real.

verses.reflection: Jesus blessed people who believe without seeing Him. That includes you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I have not seen You, but I choose to trust You.

moods.label: Sick
moods.intro: In sickness, Jesus is near. Bring Him your body, your pain, and your fears.

verses.reflection: A woman who had been sick for twelve years reached out to Jesus. He stopped, saw her, called her "Daughter," and sent her away in peace.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I reach out to You. Please see me and give me Your peace.

verses.reflection: When you are sick, God wants you to ask His people to pray for you. You do not have to be sick alone.
verses.prayer: Lord, lead me to people who will pray for me, and hear their prayers.

verses.reflection: God cares for people lying sick in bed. He strengthens them and tends to them.
verses.prayer: Lord, strengthen me here in my sickbed.

verses.reflection: This is a short prayer you can say many times: "Heal me, O Lord."
verses.prayer: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed.

verses.reflection: David reminds his own soul not to forget God's good gifts: He forgives and He heals.
verses.prayer: Lord, I will not forget all You have done for me.

verses.reflection: This prophecy points to Jesus. He was wounded for us, and by His wounds we are healed and given peace with God.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You for being wounded for me.

verses.reflection: Even when our bodies grow weaker, God can make our inner life new day by day.
verses.prayer: Lord, renew me inside, day by day.

verses.reflection: David cried out to God for help, and God healed him. Cry out to Him too.
verses.prayer: Lord my God, I cry out to You. Please heal me.

verses.reflection: Our suffering now is real, but it is small compared to the glory God will show us.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me hope beyond this suffering.

verses.reflection: Jesus went from town to town healing all kinds of sickness. He cares about sick bodies.
verses.prayer: Jesus, Healer, look on me with mercy.

verses.reflection: John prayed that his friend would be healthy in body as well as in soul. It is good to pray for your health.
verses.prayer: Lord, I pray for health in my body and in my soul.

verses.reflection: David told God plainly that he was weak and in pain. You can be that honest with God about your body.
verses.prayer: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak.

verses.reflection: A cheerful heart is good medicine. Let God bring you small joys even on hard days.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a cheerful heart today.

moods.label: Worried about money
moods.intro: God knows what you need. Trust Him, work wisely, and seek His kingdom first.

verses.reflection: Jesus tells us to put God's kingdom first, and He promises the Father will take care of what we need.
verses.prayer: Father, I put You first. Please provide what I need.

verses.reflection: Your life is not measured by what you own. You are worth more than your bank balance.
verses.prayer: Lord, keep me from greed, and remind me what life is really about.

verses.reflection: God promises to meet the needs of His people from His great riches in Christ Jesus.
verses.prayer: God, I trust You to meet my needs.

verses.reflection: We can be content because God has promised never to leave us. His presence is worth more than money.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me be content, because You are with me.

verses.reflection: An old man looked back over his life and saw that God had cared for those who trusted Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for caring for me through my whole life.

verses.reflection: This wise prayer asks for neither too much nor too little, just enough to stay close to God.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me what I need, and keep me close to You.

verses.reflection: We brought nothing into the world and cannot take anything out. Being godly and content is great wealth.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to be content with food and clothing.

verses.reflection: Jesus taught us to ask God for today's bread. You can bring your daily needs to Him.
verses.prayer: Father, give me this day my daily bread.

verses.reflection: Debt can make a person feel like a servant. God's wisdom invites us to be careful with borrowing.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom with money and help me get free of debt.

verses.reflection: Those who seek the Lord will not lack any good thing. God knows what is truly good for you.
verses.prayer: Lord, I seek You first. Thank You for every good thing.

verses.reflection: God is able to give you enough of His grace for every need, and enough to do good to others.
verses.prayer: God, give me what I need and make me generous.

verses.reflection: Careful planning leads to having enough, while rushing leads to need. Ask God to help you plan well.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me plan carefully and work hard.

verses.reflection: Paul learned to be content both with a lot and with very little. Contentment is something we can learn.
verses.prayer: Lord, teach me to be content whatever I have.

verses.reflection: God feeds the ravens, and Jesus says you are worth much more than birds.
verses.prayer: Father, thank You that I am precious to You.

moods.label: Hurt by someone
moods.intro: When someone has wounded you, Jesus understands. He can heal you and help you forgive.

verses.reflection: While being nailed to the cross, Jesus prayed for the people hurting Him. He knows what it is to be wronged, and He shows the way of forgiveness.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You were hurt too. Help me to forgive like You.

verses.reflection: Jesus asks us to love and pray for those who hurt us. Praying for them is a place to start.
verses.prayer: Lord, I pray for the one who hurt me. Bless them and heal me.

verses.reflection: We forgive others because Christ forgave us. Forgiving does not mean what they did was okay.
verses.prayer: Lord, You forgave me. Help me forgive.

verses.reflection: When you pray, Jesus asks you to let go of what you hold against others, as your Father forgives you.
verses.prayer: Father, I choose to let go of what I hold against them.

verses.reflection: Do not pay back evil with evil. As far as it depends on you, live at peace with others.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me do my part to live at peace.

verses.reflection: David was hurt most by a close friend. God understands the special pain of betrayal.
verses.prayer: Lord, You see how much this betrayal hurts. Comfort me.

verses.reflection: Joseph's brothers meant to harm him, but God turned it into something good. God can bring good out of what was meant for harm.
verses.prayer: Lord, bring good out of what was meant to hurt me.

verses.reflection: When Jesus was insulted, He did not insult back. He trusted Himself to God, who judges fairly.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust You to judge fairly. Keep me from striking back.

verses.reflection: Peter asked how many times he must forgive. Jesus' answer means: keep on forgiving.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a heart that keeps forgiving.

verses.reflection: This prophecy about Jesus says He was rejected and knew deep sorrow. He understands your pain from the inside.
verses.prayer: Jesus, Man of sorrows, You understand my pain.

verses.reflection: Love is patient and kind and does not keep a list of wrongs. God's love in us can slowly heal old wounds.
verses.prayer: Lord, fill me with Your patient and kind love.

verses.reflection: It can be a beautiful thing to overlook an offense. Ask God if this is one you can let go.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom to know what to let go.

verses.reflection: The Lord is a safe place for those who are treated badly. Run to Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are my refuge. I run to You.

moods.label: In pain
moods.intro: When life hurts because of what has happened to you, God has not left you. Jesus knows suffering from the inside.

verses.reflection: Jesus did not promise a life without trouble. He promised His peace in the middle of it, because He has overcome the world.
verses.prayer: Jesus, give me Your peace in this trouble.

verses.reflection: This prophecy about Jesus says He carried our griefs and sorrows. Your pain is not foreign to Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You carried sorrow. Carry mine with me.

verses.reflection: Even people who love God go through many troubles. The Lord does not leave them there; He delivers them.
verses.prayer: Lord, deliver me out of this trouble.

verses.reflection: Pressed, confused, struck down, but not crushed, not in despair, not abandoned, not destroyed. With God, hard is not the end.
verses.prayer: Lord, I am hurting, but I am not forsaken. Hold me up.

verses.reflection: Paul faced terrible hardships and still called them light and short compared to the glory ahead. Look past what you see to what God is doing.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me see beyond this pain to Your glory.

verses.reflection: The pain of now is real, but it cannot compare with the glory God will show His children.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me hope beyond what I am suffering now.

verses.reflection: This does not say every hard thing is good. It says God works in all things for good for those who love Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, I trust You to work good even out of this.

verses.reflection: Even if your whole world feels like it is falling apart, God is your refuge, strength and present help.
verses.prayer: God, be my refuge while my world is shaking.

verses.reflection: God does not say you will avoid deep waters or fire. He says He will be with you as you go through them.
verses.prayer: Lord, walk with me through the waters and the fire.

verses.reflection: Suffering lasts a while, but God Himself will restore, strengthen and settle you.
verses.prayer: God of all grace, restore and strengthen me.

verses.reflection: Job lost almost everything and still believed God knew his path. Trials can bring us out like refined gold.
verses.prayer: Lord, You know the way I am taking. Bring me through.

verses.reflection: God sees your trouble and knows your soul in hard times. You are not unnoticed.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that You see my trouble and know my soul.

verses.reflection: The Lord is good and a strong place to hide in the day of trouble. He knows those who trust Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are my stronghold today.

verses.reflection: In deep distress David cried to God, and God heard him. Your cry reaches His ears too.
verses.prayer: Lord, I cry out to You in my distress. Hear me.

moods.label: Grateful
moods.intro: A thankful heart turns good gifts back toward the Giver.

verses.reflection: Jesus healed ten men, but only one came back to say thank you. Jesus noticed, and He was glad for that one thankful heart.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I come back to say thank You.

verses.reflection: Giving thanks in every situation is God's will for us in Christ Jesus. There is always something to thank Him for.
verses.prayer: Lord, I give thanks in this situation.

verses.reflection: Thanksgiving is like the gate into God's presence. Start your prayers with thank You.
verses.prayer: Lord, I enter Your presence with thanks and praise.

verses.reflection: God is good, and His mercy never ends. That alone is a reason to give thanks.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Lord, for You are good and Your mercy lasts forever.

verses.reflection: Every good gift in your life comes from God the Father, who never changes.
verses.prayer: Father, thank You for every good gift You have given me.

verses.reflection: David called on everything inside him to praise God's holy name. Gratitude can fill your whole self.
verses.prayer: Bless the Lord, O my soul.

verses.reflection: Whatever you say or do, do it in Jesus' name and give thanks to God through Him.
verses.prayer: Lord Jesus, I offer You my words and work today with thanks.

verses.reflection: Today is a day God made. Choose to rejoice in it.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for this day. I will rejoice in it.

verses.reflection: God's greatest gift, His Son Jesus, is so great that words cannot fully describe Him.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, for the gift of Jesus.

verses.reflection: Thankfulness grows when we tell others what God has done.
verses.prayer: Lord, I praise You with my whole heart and will tell of Your works.

verses.reflection: David looked at his life and saw that God had given him good things. Take time to notice your blessings.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for the good places You have put me.

verses.reflection: We give thanks always, for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.prayer: Father, I thank You for everything, in Jesus' name.

verses.reflection: A life rooted in Christ overflows with thankfulness.
verses.prayer: Lord, root me in You and make me overflow with thanks.

verses.reflection: Before Jesus fed the crowd, He gave thanks for a small meal. He shows us how to thank God for what we have.
verses.prayer: Jesus, teach me to give thanks for what I have, even when it seems small.

moods.label: Joyful
moods.intro: Joy is a gift from God. Celebrate it with Him.

verses.reflection: Jesus wants His own joy to live in you and make your joy full. True joy is found in being close to Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, fill me with Your joy.

verses.reflection: The joy that comes from the Lord makes His people strong.
verses.prayer: Lord, let Your joy be my strength.

verses.reflection: Paul wrote this from prison. Joy in the Lord does not depend on how things are going.
verses.prayer: Lord, I rejoice in You today.

verses.reflection: Full joy is found in God's presence. Enjoy being with Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, I want to enjoy Your presence.

verses.reflection: Name the great things God has done for you, and let them make you glad.
verses.prayer: Lord, You have done great things for me. I am glad!

verses.reflection: Heaven celebrates when one person turns back to God. Every person matters to God.
verses.prayer: Father, thank You for the joy in heaven when someone comes home to You.

verses.reflection: Believers love Jesus without seeing Him, and trusting Him brings a joy too big for words.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I love You, and I rejoice in You.

verses.reflection: God can turn sadness into dancing. Thank Him for the changes He has brought.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for turning my mourning into dancing.

verses.reflection: God's people go out with joy and peace, and even creation seems to celebrate with them.
verses.prayer: Lord, lead me out today with joy and peace.

verses.reflection: The angel brought good news of great joy for all people: a Savior was born, Christ the Lord.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, for the good news of Jesus our Savior.

verses.reflection: Joy is possible even in hard tests, because God uses them to grow patience in us.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me find joy even in my trials.

verses.reflection: Serving God is not meant to be gloomy. Come to Him with gladness and singing.
verses.prayer: Lord, I come before You with a happy song.

verses.reflection: Jesus invites us to ask the Father in His name, so that our joy may be full.
verses.prayer: Father, in Jesus' name I bring You my requests.

verses.reflection: Even if everything failed, the prophet chose to rejoice in God. Joy in God runs deeper than circumstances.
verses.prayer: Lord, whatever happens, I will rejoice in You.

moods.label: Hopeful
moods.intro: Hope in God is not wishful thinking. It is anchored in Jesus.

verses.reflection: Jesus came so that we may have life, full and overflowing. The enemy takes away, but Jesus gives.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You for the full life You give.

verses.reflection: God spoke these words to His people in exile. His thoughts toward them were of peace and a future, and His heart is still good toward His people.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that Your thoughts toward me are of peace.

verses.reflection: Hard times build patience, character, and hope. And hope in God will not let us down, because His love fills our hearts.
verses.prayer: God, use even my troubles to grow hope in me.

verses.reflection: When the Lord is your portion, the best thing you have, you can always hope in Him.
verses.prayer: Lord, You are my portion. I will hope in You.

verses.reflection: Hope in Jesus is like an anchor that holds your soul steady in any storm.
verses.prayer: Jesus, be the anchor of my soul.

verses.reflection: God can make a road through the wilderness and rivers in the desert. Watch for the new thing He is doing.
verses.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to the new thing You are doing.

verses.reflection: Because Jesus rose from the dead, we have a living hope. Our hope is alive because He is alive.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, for a living hope through the risen Jesus.

verses.reflection: When you ask what you are really waiting for, the answer is God Himself.
verses.prayer: Lord, my hope is in You.

verses.reflection: We hope for what we cannot see yet, so we wait for it patiently.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me wait with patience and hope.

verses.reflection: Those who hope in the Lord can take courage. He will strengthen your heart.
verses.prayer: Lord, strengthen my heart as I hope in You.

verses.reflection: God says, "I make all things new." This is the future He promises.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You that You are making all things new.

verses.reflection: God finishes what He starts. The good work He began in you will be completed.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for finishing the work You started in me.

verses.reflection: Christians look forward to the blessed hope: the glorious appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.prayer: Lord Jesus, I look forward to the day You appear.

verses.reflection: Hope is a choice we can keep making, and it leads to more and more praise.
verses.prayer: Lord, I will keep hoping and keep praising You.

moods.label: Need guidance
moods.intro: God guides His people. Listen to Jesus, read His Word, and seek wise counsel.

verses.reflection: Jesus is the Good Shepherd. His sheep know His voice and follow Him. Getting to know His words helps you recognize His voice.
verses.prayer: Jesus, my Shepherd, help me hear Your voice and follow You.

verses.reflection: Make your plans, but hold them with open hands. The Lord guides your steps.
verses.prayer: Lord, here are my plans. Direct my steps.

verses.reflection: God cares about the steps of those who walk with Him, and He delights in their way.
verses.prayer: Lord, order my steps today.

verses.reflection: God often guides us through wise people. For big choices, ask trusted believers for advice.
verses.prayer: Lord, lead me to wise counsel.

verses.reflection: God promises to guide His people always and to satisfy them even in dry seasons.
verses.prayer: Lord, guide me continually and refresh my soul.

verses.reflection: God guides the humble. A teachable heart is ready to be led.
verses.prayer: Lord, make me humble and teachable.

verses.reflection: As God renews your mind, you learn to recognize His good and perfect will.
verses.prayer: Lord, renew my mind so I can know Your will.

verses.reflection: Jesus does not only show the way. He is the way, the truth, and the life.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You are my way. I follow You.

verses.reflection: The best guidance prayer is not just "tell me what to do" but "teach me to do Your will."
verses.prayer: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God.

verses.reflection: A wise life is built on hearing Jesus' words and doing them.
verses.prayer: Jesus, help me build my life on Your words.

verses.reflection: Let the peace of Christ be like a referee in your heart as you decide.
verses.prayer: Lord, let Your peace rule in my heart.

verses.reflection: Some guidance is already clear: do what is right, love mercy, and walk humbly with God.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with You.

verses.reflection: Jesus prayed honestly about what He wanted, and then said to the Father, "Not my will, but thine." He shows us how to pray about a hard choice.
verses.prayer: Father, not my will, but Yours be done.

moods.label: New to faith
moods.intro: Welcome! Here are some first steps for following Jesus.

verses.reflection: This is the good news in one verse: God loves the world so much that He gave His Son. Everyone who believes in Him has eternal life.
verses.prayer: God, thank You for loving me and giving Your Son for me.

verses.reflection: Everyone who receives Jesus and believes in Him is given the right to become a child of God.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I receive You. Thank You for making me God's child.

verses.reflection: In Christ you are a new creation. The old has gone, and the new has come.
verses.prayer: Lord, thank You for making me new.

verses.reflection: Salvation is simple: say that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead.
verses.prayer: Jesus, You are Lord. I believe God raised You from the dead.

verses.reflection: You are saved by God's grace through faith, not by being good enough. It is God's gift.
verses.prayer: Thank You, God, for saving me by grace as a gift.

verses.reflection: Jesus promises that He will never turn away anyone who comes to Him.
verses.prayer: Jesus, thank You for welcoming me.

verses.reflection: God did not wait for us to be good. Christ died for us while we were still sinners.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for dying for me.

verses.reflection: God wants you to know, not just hope, that you have eternal life through His Son.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me rest in the eternal life You give.

verses.reflection: The first Christians grew by learning God's Word, sharing life together, remembering Jesus, and praying.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me grow with other believers.

verses.reflection: All Scripture is breathed out by God and helps you grow. Read a little every day.
verses.prayer: Lord, help me love Your Word and read it every day.

verses.reflection: A baby needs milk to grow. A new believer grows by taking in God's Word.
verses.prayer: Lord, give me a hunger for Your Word.

verses.reflection: Jesus knocks and waits. When you open the door, He comes in and shares life with you.
verses.prayer: Jesus, I open the door. Come in.

verses.reflection: Following Jesus is not meant to be done alone. Meet with other believers and encourage each other.
verses.prayer: Lord, lead me to a church family.

verses.reflection: When someone turns to God, there is joy in heaven. Heaven is glad you are here.
verses.prayer: Thank You, Father, for the joy of coming home to You.
